newsitem.title: INDIA: ICI India may buy Unilever India unit.
newsitem.headline: ICI India may buy Unilever India unit.

text.p: ICI India Limited, a subsidiary of ICI Plc, has said it sees the possibility of acquiring the speciality chemicals business of Hindustan Lever Limited, the leading Indian unit of Unilever Plc.

"There is a possibility of Hindustan Lever selling its speciality chemicals business to us as has happened globally between Unilever and ICI Plc," ICI India chairman A.S. Ganguly told reporters on Thursday.
ICI Plc recently bought Unilever's speciality chemicals division worldwide, except for Indian unit. This has led to speculation that a similar devlopment may follow in India.
Ganguly said ICI was now poised for a bright future following changes in its parent company after the acquisition of Unilever's speciality chemicals business.
Ganguly said the company planned to grow "organically" and also with the help of acquisitions and strategic partnerships.
"The opportunities for acquisitions and strategic partnerships are being actively explored," he said.
He said ICI had signed a memorandum of understanding with Gujarat State Fertilisers and Chemicals Ltd for a possible joint venture to make acrylic derivatives.
